title: Poppie listing batch input (config/assets.json)
description: Read by script/BuildListingBatch.s.sol. One entry per collateral token.

symbol.description: Label used in diffs and batch names.

mechanism.description: Issuer mechanism (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Issuers). balance-changing and distributing are wrapped.

riskClass.description: Steward risk class; also the oracle price class.

hubIndex.description: Index into the deployment's hubs: the band hub for long tail (must match riskClass), any hub for BlueChip.

seedAmount.description: Raw token units paid by the deployer key. Wrapped assets need twice this amount.

supplyCapCeiling.description: Escrow supply cap ceiling in raw token units (set by MS_OPS; binds K_LOOSEN). Launch supply cap is 25% of it.
